name: WireGuard
author: marska
description: NetworkManager WireGuard tunnel in the Omarchy bar: popup with an on/off switch, ping, throughput, peer and DNS details.

barWidget.description: Left click opens the popup (switch, ping, traffic, peer, DNS), right click toggles the tunnel, middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Connection name
schema.description: NetworkManager connection to control. Empty means the first WireGuard connection.

schema.label: Ping host
schema.description: Host pinged through the tunnel. Empty means the tunnel's DNS server.

schema.label: DNS test host
schema.description: Name resolved through the tunnel to time DNS lookups.
